summary: LDAP field-level privacy is configured and restart-persistent on both nodes. Credentials are stored root-only at /srv/legacy2/ldap-attribute-privacy/demo-credentials.env on node1; no secrets are included here.
actions_performed: Installed the AlmaLinux-compatible 389 Directory Server on node1 and LDAP client tools on both nodes.
Loaded the supplied HR record while retaining the original LDIF.
Created dedicated directory-reader and hr-admin identities.
Applied ACIs allowing the reader only employee names/mail and reserving employeeNumber read/write for hr-admin.
Verified anonymous, reader, and administrator permissions remotely from node2.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and recovery.
Confirmed AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6 remained installed.

evidence.requirement: Supplied records loaded and retained on node1

evidence.requirement: Anonymous users see no employee records
evidence.summary: Anonymous employee search count was zero before and after restart testing.
Dedicated directory-reader and hr-admin entries exist; the credential file is root-owned with mode 0600.
